purpose: T88: hourly-scale baseline signal arms on the BTC pilot intraday cohort — the 1h-scale analog of the T82 daily benchmark. Measurement only; pilot is single-asset, single-month, n=716 -> explicitly low power, any FDR-pass is provisional.

cohort.label: label.forward_return_bps (4h forward mark move, bps, gross)

pit.percentile: trailing-90-record (~90h) mid-rank percentile, window excludes current record
pit.momentum_raw: mom_1h = log(mark[i]/mark[i-1]); mom_4h = log(mark[i]/mark[i-4]); each then percentiled over its own trailing-90 window
pit.eval_rows: rows where ALL six arm scores are defined (i>=94) -> common n for fair cross-arm comparison

arms.mom_1h: trailing 1-bar mark log return percentile -> 4h fwd bps (momentum vs reversal)
arms.mom_4h: trailing 4-bar mark log return percentile -> 4h fwd bps (momentum vs reversal)
arms.funding_pct: last_funding_rate percentile -> 4h fwd bps (hourly analog of the daily confirmed signal)

metrics.primary: Spearman rho (score, fwd_bps), normal-approx t/p per project convention
metrics.secondary: Welch top-quintile vs bottom-quintile mean diff on fwd_bps
metrics.fdr: BH-FDR alpha=0.05 over the 6 arm primary p-values (momentum hypothesis contributes two lookback arms; strictly more conservative than collapsing to 5 cells)

controls.placebo: labels shuffled within dataset, 2 deterministic seeds (LCG Fisher-Yates); real signal requires |rho| > max|placebo rho|

verdict_rules: PROVISIONAL_PASS = FDR-survive AND |rho|>placebo band (flagged provisional: pilot n, single asset, single month); else NO_SIGNAL
